summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC as a foreign issuer, reporting total voting rights and the admission of 14,807 ordinary shares under an existing block admission for employee share schemes. The filing is a routine disclosure of capital structure changes under UK regulation (DTR 5.6.1 and POATRs PRM 1.6.4R), not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic events are present. This is a standard update on share count and voting rights, with no implications for merger arbitrage or other special-situation analysis.
